name: The Gunman of Goldwood
review:
The Gunman of Goldwood is a 3x5, 10-line western with multiplier wilds, duels, and free spins with retriggers and random wilds.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 7,500x cap. The published RTP is 94.31%.

Duels and multiplier wilds give the base game some bite, and random wilds land during the free spins. The 3x5 layout keeps it easy to follow.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
